title: The 5 Most Common Elements in Your Body, Ranked (#1 Isn't Carbon)

scenes.text: Your body's five most common elements, ranked by mass. Number one is not carbon.

scenes.label: Calcium · ~1.3%
scenes.text: Number five: calcium. About one and a half percent of your body mass, mostly locked in your bones and teeth.

scenes.label: Nitrogen · ~3%
scenes.text: Number four: nitrogen. Roughly three percent of your mass, and it is in every protein and strand of DNA.

scenes.label: Hydrogen · ~9.5%
scenes.text: Number three: hydrogen. About nine and a half percent of your mass, mostly inside the water in your cells.

scenes.label: Carbon · ~18.5%
scenes.text: Number two: carbon. About eighteen and a half percent of you, the backbone of life's molecules.

scenes.label: Oxygen · ~65%
scenes.text: Number one: oxygen. About sixty-five percent of your body mass, mostly because you are around two thirds water.

description:
The five most common elements in the human body, ranked by share of body mass.
From calcium to oxygen, which makes up about sixty-five percent of you. Figures vary a little from person to person.
Did you expect oxygen to beat carbon by that much?
first_comment: Did you guess oxygen at number one? And what should we rank next?
